items.prompt: Which animal has feathers?

items.prompt: How many legs does a spider have?

items.prompt: Insects have 6 legs. Which animal is an insect?

items.prompt: A penguin has feathers, wings and a beak. It cannot fly. What is it?

Insects have 6 legs. A penguin has 2 legs.

hints: Look at what covers its body.

items.explanation: A penguin is a bird. All birds have feathers, wings and a beak, even birds that cannot fly.

items.prompt: Which body part helps a duck swim?

items.explanation: A duck has webbed feet. The skin between its toes pushes the water like a paddle.
